name: shell-topbar-grid
description: Top navigation + a lead band + a widget grid of independent tiles. The lead (page heading, a browse band, a notice) runs full width above the tiles; the tiles are the board.
provenPattern: Shell matrix — chrome × body: 5 chromes × 4 bodies = 20, four eliminated (with no chrome a grid has no way out, a dense surface has no interaction, a split refutes itself) → 16 cells.

knowledge.purpose: The frame of a scanned board: every tile is fed from its own source; the user scans, not reads
antiPatterns: Turning the tiles into one long content area — that is the flow body
Giving one tile the full page height — a board must be scanned at a glance
Leaving scan order to grid order — on a narrow screen priority must be declared SEPARATELY
Putting a page band among the tiles — it becomes one squeezed cell; it belongs in the lead above them
Leaving the current page unmarked — the reader cannot tell where in the app they are

A footer that differs from the other topbar shells — the footer here is the same section (divider, then the legal line) as shell-topbar-flow, so an app mixing the two shells shows one footer on every page

mobileCollapse: The top bar collapses into a drawer; links are listed in one column. The grid collapses to one column and tile priority is declared SEPARATELY — grid order does not give it.

{{ACTIVE}}.description: href of the page being viewed (e.g. /catalogue) — its top-bar link is marked current (aria-current="page"); a detail page names its parent list

placeholders.{{MAIN}}: main slot — the LEAD, full width above the tiles: the page heading and the band(s) the screen is opened for (a browse band, a filter, a notice); leave it empty when the tiles say it all. The TILES (cards, stats, charts) go in {{ID}}-tiles (the second region), one tile per grid cell — never a page heading or a page band in the tiles
placeholders.{{LEGAL}}: copyright / legal line — PLAIN TEXT, one line (e.g. "© 2026 Example Co."). The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. Leave it empty ("") for none
